fields.description: The surplus_recommender fab-code group this row belongs to. NOT a Link: a recommendation aggregates many Surplus Stock lots, so no single master row exists. Identity here is (fab_code, batch) — one row per dye lot on the board — but this alone stays the join key for Moodboard Surplus Recolour, which is shared across all of a fab code's batches.
fields.label: Fab Code

fields.description: Whether THIS batch is on the board. All recommendations are stored; the user's picks are marked selected. Mirrors Moodboard Fabric. A fab code the user took five batches of has five selected rows; one they passed over has a single unselected row carrying the recommender's default batch.
fields.label: Selected

fields.description: How the fabric got onto the board: 'recommended' (surplus_recommender.recommend) or 'library' (browsed from the catalogue). Library picks carry no match_score / reason / brief attribution, so the UI needs to tell them apart.
fields.label: Source

fields.description: Position in the recommender's returned order (0-based), preserved so the board can re-render the ranking it was shown.
fields.label: Rank

fields.description: 'llm' when the LLM re-rank picked it, 'score' when it was backfilled from the deterministic ranking.
fields.label: Match Source

fields.description: The LLM's written rationale. Promoted to a column (rather than left in `recommendation`) because it is what a user asks about later.
fields.label: Reason

fields.description: The raw blend string as stocked, e.g. '95% Cotton/5% Spandex'.
fields.label: Composition

fields.description: Comma-joined colourway names as stocked. Small Text, not Data: a fab code can carry 20+ colourways and the join overruns 140 chars. The per-colour detail is in `colors`.
fields.label: Colour

fields.description: The dye lot this row is for. Half of the row's identity: a fab code stocked in five palette colours is five rows here, one per batch, each independently selectable. Image URLs are not stored — they are rebuilt from this on read as plain public asset URLs (never presigned, so the client can cache them).
fields.label: Batch

fields.description: This batch's own colour as the mill recorded it, denormalised so the board renders a tile without re-reading Surplus Stock. Raw mill text and often truncated ('Wht-Whi', 'Blac') — display palette_name where there is one.
fields.label: Batch Colour

fields.description: The brief palette colour this batch was picked to serve, when the recommendation was colour-matched. Empty for a fabric chosen on construction alone.
fields.label: Palette Colour Id

fields.description: The palette colour's display name, e.g. 'Ocean Blue'. What the tile should be labelled with — batch_color is the mill's raw text.
fields.label: Palette Colour Name

fields.description: Whether this batch had a swatch photographed when it was added. Lets the board show a no-image tile without a stock lookup per row.
fields.label: Has Image

fields.description: Colourway variants (JSON array) as returned by the recommender — rendered as a swatch row, never queried.
fields.label: Colour Variants

fields.description: The raw recommendation object verbatim, minus the expiring image_url/thumbnail. Nothing the recommender returns is lost, and a new field there needs no migration here.
fields.label: Raw Recommendation
